0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000010_YSHTOLA
0.description: Your business with Tataru is finished?

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000020_YSHTOLA
1.description: My, what a thoughtful surprise. Whatever would we do without her?

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000030_THANCRED
2.description: Indeed. And she's right, you know─it hasn't been all doom and gloom.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000040_YSHTOLA
3.description: It feels like a lifetime ago that Master Louisoix gathered us together to form the Circle of Knowing.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000050_YSHTOLA
4.description: Since then, we have experienced much. But rather than feeling wiser, the more I learn, the more I find my knowledge lacking.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000060_URIANGER
5.description: Forsooth. As a student, vainly did I believe that I held the secrets of creation in my grasp. Yet that which I had seized was but an insignificant sliver of what awaited in the wider world.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000070_URIANGER
6.description: Every encounter, every experience, hath served to open mine eyes, enlightening and humbling me in equal measure. Even from those whom I called enemies have I learned many a valuable lesson.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000080_YSHTOLA
7.description: What will we learn at the edge of the universe, I wonder...

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000090_THANCRED
8.description: Ultima Thule, where the bringer of the end makes her nest... I for one can't possibly imagine.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000100_THANCRED
9.description: But whatever awaits us there, we will survive. We <hex:021A020203>must<hex:021A020103>... For her.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
11.description: You've nothing left to prove. Not to Ryne. Nor Minfilia.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_A1_000_003_NONE_VOICE
13.description: Just make sure you bring enough ammunition.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000130_THANCRED
16.description: No, it's nothing. I just... Well, lately I find myself surprised at how much I've changed. How much we've all changed.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000150_THANCRED
18.description: Gods, it feels like only yesterday that we went on that mission to Drybone.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000160_THANCRED
19.description: We've both changed much since then, have we not?

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000170_THANCRED
20.description: O ye of little faith. I know better than to leave home without ample supplies, thank you very much─I didn't pick up the gunblade yesterday.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000180_THANCRED
21.description: And to think I used to prefer fighting from the shadows. Gods, I really have changed.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000190_YSHTOLA
23.description: We've come far together, and if we have aught to say about it, we'll go further still. Aye, we will avert this calamity and return home.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000200_YSHTOLA
24.description: In preparation for which, we must give thought to what we hope to achieve after the proverbial dust has settled.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000210_THANCRED
25.description: What with the primals and Ascians all but dealt with, I suppose we'll need to look for new hobbies.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000220_THANCRED
26.description: In all seriousness, though─in uniting to overcome a common foe, the disparate peoples of the world have found a way forward together. It's a truly gratifying sight to see.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000230_YSHTOLA
27.description: Indeed... Though it was many years in the making, we have successfully set in motion the gears of fundamental change.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000240_YSHTOLA
28.description: With this, we have fulfilled our humble role as a symbol of hope...and I daresay it is time to bow out.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000250_YSHTOLA
29.description: After all, there is no shortage of hands to bear the torch in our stead.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000260_THANCRED
30.description: You know, I never really considered I might live long enough to see an after.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000270_THANCRED
31.description: But even if my time as a Scion came to an end, I don't expect that much would change.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000280_THANCRED
32.description: Traveling the world, going wherever the wind blows, lending a hand to those in need...

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000290_URIANGER
33.description: A journey for journey's sake. It doth suit thee well. I must confess, I too have yearned to see more of the world.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000300_URIANGER
34.description: If thou art amenable to the suggestion, I would accompany thee. Mine ability to affect an air of normalcy through artful disguise is much improved, thou must concede...

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000310_THANCRED
35.description: Aye, well, improvement is relative. You still look suspicious no matter what you wear.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000320_THANCRED
36.description: What of you, Y'shtola? Any grand plans?

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000330_YSHTOLA
37.description: Why, continue my quest for knowledge, naturally. To begin with, I wish to know the state of the reflections, to which end I must find a means to travel between worlds.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000340_YSHTOLA
38.description: 'Tis the least I must do if I am to keep my promise.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000350_YSHTOLA
39.description: Should my pursuits prove unduly arduous, I won't hesitate to call on you.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000360_YSHTOLA
40.description: And in return, I will take you to see Ryne one day. I'm sure you cannot wait to see the fine young woman she has become.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000380_URIANGER
42.description: And what of thee? What wouldst thou pursue at duty's end?

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000390_WAITEROFTHELASTSTAND
43.description: Here's yours. My apologies for the wait.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000400_THANCRED
44.description: Well, shall we make a toast?

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000430_YSHTOLA
47.description: To the future of the star.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000460_KRILE
50.description: Knowing them, they're probably dreaming about the celestial adventures to come.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000470_KRILE
51.description: Just as well. They've been running themselves ragged of late.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000480_KRILE
52.description: Unlike you and the others, I'm a few steps removed from the danger and excitement. The things you all get up to never fail to impress me. But by the same token, I can't help but worry.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000490_KRILE
53.description: Not only for your safety, but...but for your happiness. After everything you've sacrificed, you earned it a thousand times over.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000500_KRILE
54.description: From the simple pleasures of tucking into a hearty meal or...or collapsing into a comfortable bed...

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000510_KRILE
55.description: To the grand triumphs of visiting legendary lands or finding true love─you deserve all the joy in the world.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000520_KRILE
56.description: There is so much that life has to offer. So much to be treasured and shared with those we hold dear.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000530_KRILE
57.description: So promise me this: come what may, you won't give up on your own happiness.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000540_KRILE
58.description: When you're out there, fighting tooth and nail, it's all too easy to forget.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000550_KRILE
59.description: But in the end, your passions will be your greatest strength of all. Remember that.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000590_GRAHATIA
63.description: Wait, what are you─? What am I─?

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000600_GRAHATIA
64.description: Gods, don't tell me I fell asleep?

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000610_KRILE
65.description: Not that there's any shame in it...but you were sleeping like babies.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000630_ALISAIE
67.description: Not a word to anyone. Understood? Not. One. Word.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000640_KRILE
68.description: I'm told that sleeping in proper beds of your own choosing is a much more effective way to prepare for battle.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000660_GRAHATIA
70.description: So...what were the two of you doing here?

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000670_KRILE
71.description: I had a few books to return to the library. Thought I'd take care of it while I could.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
75.description: Just enjoying a little peace and quiet.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000700_ALPHINAUD
78.description: Ah, so you were worried that the Leveilleur household might again be gripped by turmoil.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000720_ALPHINAUD
80.description: All is well, I assure you.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000730_ALPHINAUD
81.description: In my letters home, I had made mention of Estinien, you see.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000740_ALPHINAUD
82.description: My mother wished to meet the legend in person, and so we arranged to have a spot of tea together.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000750_ESTINIEN
83.description: Where were you in my hour of need? Fell beasts I can face, but I'm not made for idle chitchat with lords and ladies...

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000760_ALPHINAUD
84.description: Well, I for one thought you held your own. Mother was the picture of delight.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000770_ESTINIEN
85.description: Hmph. I might've been delighted myself were we in a tavern with more agreeable drink.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000780_ESTINIEN
86.description: The thought of fleeing crossed my mind, but what then? I'd never hear the end of it─least of all from Tataru.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000790_ALPHINAUD
87.description: I'm sorry... 'Twas not my intent to cause you such distress.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000800_ALPHINAUD
88.description: It's just...it was one of the things I didn't want to leave undone ere we set forth.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000810_ALPHINAUD
89.description: That's not to say I think we won't be returning...

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000820_ALPHINAUD
90.description: Yet given what lies ahead, I did not wish to leave for later that which I could do today.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000830_ALPHINAUD
91.description: After all, tomorrow is never promised.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000840_ESTINIEN
92.description: It's fine. Not like I had better things to do.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000850_ESTINIEN
93.description: Besides...seeing you with your mother brought back fond memories of my own. Be we rich or poor, family is...family.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000860_ESTINIEN
94.description: Well, it's past time we were on our way.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000880_ALPHINAUD
96.description: Since I left home, I've made a great many mistakes. Mistakes for which I can never make amends. But through it all, you didn't give up on me.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000890_ALPHINAUD
97.description: To have returned here, with you at my side... It means more to me than you know.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000900_ALPHINAUD
98.description: Thank you. From the bottom of my heart.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000920_ALPHINAUD
100.description: Forgive me, but it needed to be said.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000930_ESTINIEN
101.description: I'm the one who owes you thanks.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000940_ESTINIEN
102.description: Were it not for you, I would not be alive today, nor come to terms with Nidhogg's spirit.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_A3_000_001_NONE_VOICE
105.description: I suppose I ought to thank you both as well.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
106.description: You were never one to forsake a friend, Alphinaud.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000960_ALPHINAUD
108.description: Well, we needn't make it a competition. You know... This must be what Hydaelyn meant when She spoke about depending on one another.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000970_ALPHINAUD
109.description: However treacherous the road before us, together we will prevail.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_000990_ALPHINAUD
111.description: No, I'm not. And I'm proud of that.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001010_ESTINIEN
113.description: I know, and I won't let you down. Together, we'll show the enemy the strength of mortal will.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001020_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
114.description: That night, at the Royal Menagerie in Ala Mhigo...

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001030_ZENOS
115.description: (-Zenos viator Galvus-) “You will never get what you want...not even the battle you pine for so dearly...”

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001040_ZENOS
116.description: (-Zenos viator Galvus-)In that transcendent moment, what was it that I sought in you?

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001050_ZENOS
117.description: (-Zenos viator Galvus-)And what was it that you sought in me?

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001080_YSHTOLA
120.description: How often have we thus assembled...

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001090_YSHTOLA
121.description: To combine our knowledge and seek solutions to the problems before us.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001100_THANCRED
122.description: Back at the Waking Sands, it was all we could do to address the most minor of troubles. Who could've realized what we'd find when we began to look to the sources of the realm's woes.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001110_URIANGER
123.description: At the Rising Stones, we made great strides and shared many moments. From the joyous...to the sorrowful.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001120_ALPHINAUD
124.description: We've had occasion to call other places home too.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001130_ALPHINAUD
125.description: Be it Ishgard or Kugane, we were fortunate to find sanctuary wherein we might take stock and continue our fight.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001140_GRAHATIA
126.description: I was honored to host this company in the Crystarium. To stand with you all as we confronted the truth of the star itself.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001150_ALISAIE
127.description: And now, from this place, we go to fight the most important battle of all.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001160_KRILE
128.description: The Forum has sent word. The ark is ready.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001170_KRILE
129.description: The Loporrits, naturally, will be commanding the vessel.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001180_KRILE
130.description: They will see the eight of you to Ultima Thule.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001190_KRILE
131.description: Upon arriving, your objective is to find and vanquish Meteion.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001200_KRILE
132.description: As a final formality, the Forum bade me ascertain your resolve. So...are you certain you wish to do this?

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001220_KRILE
134.description: Then ere you report to Thaumazein, I leave you with these words.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001240_KRILE
136.description: What that means will differ for each of you.

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001250_KRILE
137.description: To make it back home, or to simply avert doom, or perhaps something else altogether...

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001260_KRILE
138.description: Yet whatever it is that drives you, I have faith in its power to see you through. So please─triumph.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001270_KRILE
139.description: Triumph, as we who remain behind believe you will.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001300_TATARU
142.description: Both Krile and I will be there to see you off, but as your receptionist, I feel I need to say this here.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001310_TATARU
143.description: Safe journey, all of you! And...be safe!

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001320_FOURCHENAULT
147.description: All present and accounted for? Good.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001330_FOURCHENAULT
148.description: As you will have heard, the ark is ready. All that remains is to board and be on your way.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001340_CID
149.description: I've seen my fair share of tight schedules, but this was bloody murder...

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001350_CID
150.description: But we did it. We finished the ship.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001360_CID
151.description: It's safe, fit for purpose, and looks good to boot. Aye, it's a Garlond through and through.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001370_GRAHATIA
152.description: I really don't know what we'd do without you. Thank you for everything.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001380_CID
153.description: Don't mention it. Ever since that episode with Omega, I've been toying with the idea of starfaring vessels.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001390_CID
154.description: And as they say, necessity is the mother of invention. We've learned a lot, let me tell you.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001400_CID
155.description: Well, the work was hard, but we've learned a lot from it. After all, it's not every day you get tasked with building a starfaring vessel.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001410_CID
156.description: In case you're wondering about payment, the ongoing existence of the world ought to do. But feel free to throw in a colorful recounting of your journey on your return.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001420_CID
157.description: So, have you thought of a name?

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001430_ALISAIE
158.description: A name? Wasn't everyone just calling it Father's “teeny-tiny toy boat”?

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001440_CID
159.description: Well, seeing as its purpose has changed, I thought a more eloquent name was in order. I suggested as much to Fourchenault, who seemed quite amenable to the idea.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001450_FOURCHENAULT
160.description: As you know, this vessel is the culmination of heretofore unprecedented collaboration.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001460_FOURCHENAULT
161.description: And though said collaboration is owed to the Scions, there is another whose noble deeds made our work possible.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001470_FOURCHENAULT
162.description: From a fragment of Dalamud, we obtained not only advanced materials such as refined adamantite, but the knowledge to traverse the stars.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001480_FOURCHENAULT
163.description: And this fragment would not have found its way to us had the Archon Louisoix not fought to protect this world─and in so doing laid down his life.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001490_FOURCHENAULT
164.description: Now that the vessel stands complete, I cannot help but wonder if it was more than mere happenstance...

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001500_FOURCHENAULT
165.description: If it was my father's intention to guide us here.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001510_FOURCHENAULT
166.description: In the hopes that his guidance will see you all safely home, I name the vessel after that selfsame fragment of Dalamud he delivered unto us.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001530_SICARD
168.description: Sorry for the wait! I got everyone you asked for, and not a one less.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001540_ALPHINAUD
169.description: What are you all doing here?

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001550_LIVINGWAY
170.description: Oh, I invited them. The representatives of those tribes with religious inclinations.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001560_LIVINGWAY
171.description: You've done a fine job of readying the <hex:021A020203>Ragnarok<hex:021A020103>, but for it to take flight, we'll of course need the power of the Mothercrystal.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001570_LIVINGWAY
172.description: Given its immense size, however, transporting it would be an absolute logistical nightmare. Not to mention we'd need to shatter it into tiny shards for feeding to the engines.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001580_LIVINGWAY
173.description: But a brilliant idea came to me: we convert the crystal's energy into forms that can transport themselves!

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001590_URIANGER
175.description: Thou wouldst employ summoning...or should I say its precursor─creation magicks.

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001600_THANCRED
176.description: Care to explain for our benefit?

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001610_URIANGER
177.description: As you may have witnessed at Bestways Burrow, the Loporrits are capable of creation magicks, which they use to shape the moon's environment.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001620_URIANGER
178.description: Yet simple though they make it seem, 'tis a highly advanced and exacting art. To perform it correctly requireth that the wielder holdeth the object in his mind's eye in clearest detail.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001630_ALPHINAUD
179.description: Hence the ancients' meticulous management of concepts.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001640_URIANGER
180.description: Drawing upon this art, the Ascians conceived of summoning as we know it.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001650_URIANGER
181.description: A derivative that replaceth the complexity of concepts with the simplicity of zealotry to make manifest a creation.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001660_YSHTOLA
182.description: I see... By combining the Loporrits' magicks and the tribes' faith, we convert the Mothercrystal into primals of purer form and greater obedience.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001670_YSHTOLA
183.description: Summoning as it was intended, one might say.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001690_LIVINGWAY
185.description: While Hydaelyn gave us the ability to use creation magicks, She forbade us from using it to make anything possessed of a soul─or similar.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001700_LIVINGWAY
186.description: She didn't say anything about fulfilling the desires of <hex:021A020203>others<hex:021A020103>, though. So! Borrowing our friends' faith, we'll create deities using the Mothercrystal's power, and send them to the <hex:021A020203>Ragnarok<hex:021A020103>!

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001710_ALISAIE
187.description: Am I the only one here concerned about the risk of being turned into a tempered minion?

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001720_LIVINGWAY
188.description: Oh, right, I was getting to that... From what I've read in Sharlayan tomes, it appears the Ascians incorporated an additional nasty element into their summoning method: the fervent desire to assimilate others into one's belief.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001730_LIVINGWAY
189.description: Beings thus created are instilled with the selfsame desire, and use their powers to enthrall people─starting with the summoner.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001740_LIVINGWAY
190.description: In contrast, our creation magicks─the original and the best, accept no substitutes─don't incorporate any of that rubbish, so there's no risk of tempering. I mean, if the being was on the scale of Zodiark, you might feel a little “tug”...but I think we'll be safe enough.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001750_SOROBAN
191.description: Truth be told, I do not understand the intricacies of this plan. But none of us would ever turn our backs on you.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001760_SOROBAN
192.description: When the avatars of our faith ran amok, you intervened without decrying we who birthed them.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001770_SOROBAN
193.description: Where others vilified and suppressed us, you offered understanding and friendship.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001780_SOROBAN
194.description: In gratitude, we will share with you the true expressions of our gods─not malevolent deities, but benevolent saviors!

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001790_SICARD
195.description: All right, you lot, we're headin' to the aetherial sea. Stay in sight else you're liable to get lost.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001820_WILFSUNN
198.description: In anticipation of the day man might journey to the stars, we developed these.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001830_BLOEWYDA
199.description: Portable teleportation devices. One for each of you, designed to work in tandem.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001840_BLOEWYDA
200.description: Press the button on one, and in a matter of moments all eight will activate and send their owners back to the <hex:021A020203>Ragnarok<hex:021A020103>.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001850_BLOEWYDA
201.description: There is no telling what hazards you may encounter. If you find yourselves separated or lost, please do not hesitate to use them.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001860_BLOEWYDA
202.description: Be safe, all of you. And come back.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001870_URIANGER
203.description: You as well. I pray you take care.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001880_LIVINGWAY
204.description: Looks like everything is in order, so I'll go ahead and board.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001890_LIVINGWAY
205.description: A few of my fellows will remain to assist with the summonings, but rest assured the vessel won't want for competent crewing.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001900_FOURCHENAULT
206.description: If you are ready, then you should board as well. Go...and godsspeed.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001920_LIVINGWAY
208.description: I hope you have everything, because I can't be bothered turning back.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001930_LIVINGWAY
209.description: Right then, make yourselves comfortable. We're setting off in just a moment.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001950_FOURCHENAULT
211.description: This is Fourchenault. Can you hear me?

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001960_FOURCHENAULT
212.description: The preparations for the summonings are complete.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001970_FOURCHENAULT
213.description: In accordance with the fourteenth phase of the plan, we have moved the <hex:021A020203>Ragnarok<hex:021A020103> to the launch site.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_001980_FOURCHENAULT
214.description: The gates are open. You may depart when ready.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002000_ALISAIE
216.description: As ready as we'll ever be. Let's get going.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002010_MAPPINGWAY
217.description: Oh, come on! A burnt-out star's got more fire in its belly!

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002040_ALISAIE
223.description: No need to be coy, Brother. Do it, and do it well!

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002070_ALPHINAUD
226.description: Onward─unto the distant stars and beyond!

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002150_GARUDA
234.description: That I must carry <hex:021A020203>landwalkers<hex:021A020103> into the sky... I cannot imagine a greater indignity!

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002160_SUSANO
235.description: Do not sulk so. For thy mighty winds exist not only to buffet and batter.

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002170_SUSANO
236.description: Nay, they may serve also to thrust forth with vigor. Such is thy glory...and thus it is an occasion to rejoice!

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002200_GARUDA
239.description: So long as the wind blows freely, I suppose all is as it should be in creation...

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002210_GARUDA
240.description: I will render unto them a storm, that they may pierce the firmament and fly free!

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002250_SLEEPINGWAY
244.description: Thanks to the power of those primals, the engines are roaring and we're ripping along!

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002260_MAPPINGWAY
245.description: All values are also within projected ranges. Time to destination is eight carrots. Perhaps seven at a pinch.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002270_LIVINGWAY
246.description: All right, let's go over some points of caution.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002280_LIVINGWAY
247.description: Our destination, as you know, is Ultima Thule. Lest you wonder, the place is not a star so much as...a patch of emptiness.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002290_LIVINGWAY
248.description: That's the extent of what our equipment could determine, anyway.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002300_LIVINGWAY
249.description: From what we know of Meteion, she's likely used dynamis to obfuscate her location.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002310_YSHTOLA
250.description: So in conclusion, we'll only know what's there when we get there.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002320_LIVINGWAY
251.description: The crew and I will see to it the ship's ready to take off at a moment's notice.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002330_LIVINGWAY
252.description: We'll support the search as best we can, but it'll be your paws on the ground...assuming there is any.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002340_LIVINGWAY
253.description: But everything will be fine, I'm sure. Hydaelyn believes in you, so you ought to believe in yourselves.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002350_LIVINGWAY
254.description: Just don't do anything I wouldn't. Like waiting too long to use those portable teleporters of yours.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002360_LIVINGWAY
255.description: Personally, at the slightest sign of trouble, I'd mash the button to bits─and you should as well.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002370_ALPHINAUD
256.description: Understood. We promise to be careful.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002380_MAPPINGWAY
257.description: I suggest you brace yourselves. We're about to arrive, and the vessel will shake a good bit.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002400_MAPPINGWAY
259.description: Something is interfering with the equipment...

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002450_METEION
267.description: Oh? Have you met one of my sisters?

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002460_METEION
268.description: I don't remember meeting you myself... But I do know that you're from Etheirys.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002470_METEION
269.description: Why have you come? All you had to do was wait. I would've delivered to you your ends.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002490_METEION
271.description: I don't understand. All life is destined to end.

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002500_METEION
272.description: Why choose to prolong your suffering?

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002510_METEION
273.description: Effort, ambition, love─they amount to naught. Happiness, should you find it, is inevitably lost. Stolen away by events beyond your control.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002520_METEION
274.description: There is no logic nor meaning in it. You think there is, convince yourselves, but it's all a cruel accident.

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002530_METEION
275.description: Come now, I speak the truth. A truth you would recognize if you looked up at the night sky.

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002540_METEION
276.description: Unbroken emptiness. Cold, dark, and silent. Your world, like every other, is but a blemish upon its perfect fabric.

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002550_METEION
277.description: Life is an anomaly. It is unnatural and cannot continue. The sooner you accept this, the easier it will be.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002560_YSHTOLA
278.description: Just to be clear, we're not here to argue with you.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002570_YSHTOLA
279.description: We know that life is fleeting. And that in the short time we have it, we're not assured happiness.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002580_THANCRED
280.description: Indeed, I've seen far more sorrow in the eyes of many I've met.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002590_THANCRED
281.description: I myself have plenty of regrets, and one day they'll die with me. Gone to dust with my “good” deeds and unfulfilled dreams.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002600_ALPHINAUD
282.description: But we accept this. That our existence may seem pointless. That sorrow, rage, and despair will always dog our heels.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002610_ALPHINAUD
283.description: And we press on regardless. That is why Hydaelyn guided us here.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002620_ALPHINAUD
284.description: In Her boundless love for mankind, She has prepared us for this trial, and in Her name we have come for you!

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002630_METEION
285.description: Yes, I sense it... A burning passion, like unto fury...

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002640_METEION
286.description: I know it well. For the same passion once burned in many a star before yours.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002670_METEION
289.description: You approach the bounds of my Ultimatum, where emotions dictate reality.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002680_METEION
290.description: Where resignation and acceptance unite to embrace the end.

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002690_METEION
291.description: Where those who yet valiantly cling to life cannot thrive...

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002720_YSHTOLA
294.description: Meteion is gone as well. Mayhap he awakened first and gave chase.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002730_MAPPINGWAY
295.description: ...Uh, everyone? It appears we're at our destination.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002750_GROWINGWAY
297.description: Not that we knew what to expect...but I wasn't expecting this.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002760_GROWINGWAY
298.description: From atmospheric composition to ambient temperatures, all readings are within permissible range. This place is capable of supporting life!

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002770_LIVINGWAY
299.description: If that's the case, then Thancred may well have gone on ahead. Let's go and have a look.

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002780_LIVINGWAY
300.description: Meanwhile, I want the rest of you to perform a full inspection of the ship as well as a biological scan.

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002790_HYTHLODAEUS
301.description: So it was that the brave wayfarers arrived at last at dream's end.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002800_EMETSELCH
302.description: In following their path walked and history written, I am made keenly aware of one truth...

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002810_EMETSELCH
303.description: Though the curtains may fall again and again, so long as others take the stage, ever shall there be more tales to tell.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002820_HYTHLODAEUS
304.description: So let them bring it to a close, I say.

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002830_EMETSELCH
305.description: Let the curtains fall upon this─

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002840_EMETSELCH
306.description: The final chapter in the tale of the star.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002860_LIVINGWAY
308.description: As I live and breathe...I live and breathe. The environment itself shouldn't kill us.

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002870_YSHTOLA
309.description: Well then, let us search for Thancred while exploring the area.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002880_YSHTOLA
310.description: The ship, we leave in your care.

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002900_METEION
312.description: What you see is a memory of a world that once was.

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002910_METEION
313.description: A world suffering a slow death, whose denizens cried out for the release of oblivion.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002930_METEION
315.description: It is. Not a single life remains upon that husk floating in the vast emptiness.

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002940_METEION
316.description: These creatures are shadow and shade. Perpetuated only to suffuse dynamis with their unending lamentations.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002960_METEION
318.description: A strange question. He is at your side, is he not?

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002970_METEION
319.description: Oh yes─he is here, and there, and everywhere within this space. He would tell you himself if he had form to form words.

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002980_METEION
320.description: Huh. Such loathing and uncertainty... You don't know why you still exist.

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_002990_METEION
321.description: In like manner to the oblivion I send, I tried to drown out your aether with dynamis.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003000_METEION
322.description: Beginning with this Thancred, who came at me despite being unable to breathe.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003010_METEION
323.description: Such a simple thing, unmaking men. In the blinking of an eye, he was gone. Didn't even have the chance to be transformed.

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003020_METEION
324.description: Yet somehow, he managed to leave a sliver of himself behind.

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003030_METEION
325.description: What you call...the heart...or perhaps the soul? In his final moment, he...cried out from it. A single word...

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003060_METEION
328.description: That wish proved stronger than the despair that ruled here. It overpowered it, causing this space to be remade.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003070_METEION
329.description: Into a place you can perceive, and where life can endure.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003080_METEION
330.description: That you draw breath is proof that his soul lives on. For how long, however, remains to be seen.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003090_ESTINIEN
331.description: Well then, we should hurry and tend to business!

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003110_METEION
333.description: It's futile. You will never reach the true me.

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003120_METEION
334.description: I told you. Emotions dictate reality in this space. Such changes as you might work will not alter its nature.

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003130_METEION
335.description: You may see, but you cannot touch. Walk, but not advance.

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003150_GRAHATIA
337.description: Meteion holds too much sway here. How do we contend with a foe who can unmake us on a whim?

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003160_URIANGER
338.description: I do not know...but Thancred gave his life that we might come this far. We must press on.

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003170_YSHTOLA
339.description: Agreed. We cannot turn tail here. Not without something to show for our comrade's sacrifice.

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003180_URIANGER
340.description: He remaineth as he was when I first approached. Entombed in melancholy.

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003210_ESTINIEN
343.description: So. Waiting to die like all the others, are you?

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003220_TIREDDRAGON
344.description: Aye. Our pride is crushed, and our souls corrupted. The winds are stilled, and the heavens offer no comfort.

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003230_TIREDDRAGON
345.description: There is nothing left for our kind. Our long lives a curse as we await the end. Still as stone we shall become...

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003240_ESTINIEN
346.description: So you say, yet your kind has found a new beginning on our star.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003250_ESTINIEN
347.description: One of you braved the expanse, bearing with him a clutch of eggs. They and their children now rule our skies, their song heard by all.

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003270_TIREDDRAGON
349.description: And yet...upon thee do I smell the blood of my brethren.

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003280_TIREDDRAGON
350.description: Were they drawn into discord and war on their new home?

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003290_ESTINIEN
351.description: They were. They suffered much, and repaid their suffering in kind.

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003310_TIREDDRAGON
353.description: It mattereth not whither we fly.

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003320_TIREDDRAGON
354.description: Ever will a sanguine ocean await us. Ever will retribution's wheel turn.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003330_TIREDDRAGON
355.description: And so, on the last of my pride as a dragon, I break free of this wheel.

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003340_TIREDDRAGON
356.description: I renounce conflict! Exile myself from the other, never again to be touched by the flames of hatred!

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003350_ESTINIEN
357.description: Had your brethren made the selfsame choice, my family might still be alive.

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003360_ESTINIEN
358.description: Yet lasting peace does not come to those who simply retreat from conflict.

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003370_ESTINIEN
359.description: No, you must be willing to confront it. To stare into the face of your foe...and see yourself in him.

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003380_ESTINIEN
360.description: Only then can you break the cycle of torment and tragedy. This lesson, a dear friend taught me at the risk of his life.

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003390_ESTINIEN
361.description: There is no nobility in your “penance.” You wallow in self-pity.

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003400_ESTINIEN
362.description: And after everything we've endured, we will not let you stop us!

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003430_TIREDDRAGON
365.description: We tire of war... We tire of turmoil...

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003450_TIREDDRAGON
367.description: Our misery, our shame... Too much to bear...

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003460_TIREDDRAGON
368.description: Release us, from war... From life...

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003470_ESTINIEN
369.description: I see... Theirs is the emotion that bars our way.

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003490_ESTINIEN
371.description: The rest is up to you.

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003520_ALPHINAUD
374.description: He's opened the way for us...

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003530_ALPHINAUD
375.description: Sacrificed himself to remake this place, like Thancred did...

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003560_ALPHINAUD
378.description: Come...let us follow the wind. It will not lead us astray. He would not.

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003570_YSHTOLA
379.description: Please, continue. Tell us about this truth you discovered.

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003580_EAA
380.description: Very well. Bear in mind, however, that the purpose of this conversation is not to impart scholarly knowledge. For such requires that you comprehend the subject matter─which you will not.

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003590_EAA
381.description: We will forgo the intricacies of our scientific methodology and deal only with the conclusion─the end of our society, and our world.

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003600_EAB
382.description: We acknowledge, with regret, that your star is in the midst of the same panic-induced cataclysm that befell Deneb III.

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003610_EAB
383.description: As such, in order to avoid causing undue distress, we will refrain from explicitly stating how much time you have remaining.

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003620_YSHTOLA
384.description: You are entirely too kind. I pray you recount your tale as you see fit.

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003630_EAA
385.description: In the beginning, the universe was but a tiny particle. Then suddenly, this particle began to expand.

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003640_EAA
386.description: Having remained entirely in the bounds of your star, the phenomenon may be difficult for your kind to grasp, but this expansion has since continued unabated.

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003650_EAB
387.description: Speculating that the universe could not grow indefinitely, we sought to learn what might occur─and made a worrying discovery.

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003660_EAB
388.description: The stars will continue to spread apart, as will their finite thermal energies.

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003670_EAB
389.description: Eventually, all heavenly bodies will grow cold and freeze. No new stars will be born, and the universe will enter unto an eternal ice age.

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003680_EAA
390.description: In hopes of proving that this determination was erroneous, we scrutinized our research from all angles, even as we sought to avert the everlasting winter.

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003690_EAA
391.description: The endeavor proved fruitless. So infamously so, in fact, that it became synonymous with vain effort.

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003700_EAA
392.description: The universe as we know it would end, and there is no way to prevent it.

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003710_EAB
393.description: Beneath the weight of this knowledge, our society stagnated. Though we had time still, it was a “cold” comfort.

394.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003720_EAB
394.description: Why strive for anything when desolation is assured? When our wealth of wisdom, accumulated since the dawning of our kind, would be forever lost?

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003730_EAB
395.description: No civilization would rise from our ashes. No scholar recover our knowledge. In silence unbroken, naught would stir.

396.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003740_EAA
396.description: Intellect was once our pride. Overnight, it became our shame. Our works monuments to futility.

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003750_EAA
397.description: Immortality, our greatest invention, became a source of suffering. Rather than suffer on, many chose to unmake themselves by means of aetheric exsanguinaters.

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003760_EAA
398.description: Etched upon these stones are the testaments of such souls. Though many left no words at all, thinking it a pointless gesture.

399.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003770_EAB
399.description: Once we have obtained vessels of flesh, we likewise intend to vanish.

400.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003780_EAA
400.description: If you understand this─understand aught of our tale─you will abandon your quest for knowledge.

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003790_EAA
401.description: Ignorance truly is bliss. If you would cling to your illusory happiness, remain primitive and pure. It is the only way.

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003820_YSHTOLA
404.description: While I appreciate your advice, I will not heed it.

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003830_YSHTOLA
405.description: Convinced though you may be of this truth, it is yours and not mine. Indeed truth, I have ever believed, is in the eye of the beholder.

406.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003840_EAA
406.description: Are you suggesting that we have reached a faulty conclusion? That our science failed us?

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003850_YSHTOLA
407.description: Hardly. As you yourself said, the subject matter is beyond my comprehension.

408.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003860_YSHTOLA
408.description: And that, I accept, is true. I do not possess the knowledge to prove or disprove your conclusion.

409.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003870_YSHTOLA
409.description: In my mortal years, I doubt I could even approach the wisdom of the Ea.

410.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003880_YSHTOLA
410.description: But of one thing am I absolutely certain: I would <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> be happier in ignorance.

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003900_YSHTOLA
412.description: The most important lesson I've learned...is that learning isn't simply passing one's eyes over words.

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003910_YSHTOLA
413.description: Nay... 'Tis when understood for oneself that knowledge attains its true value.

414.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003920_YSHTOLA
414.description: This is what has sustained me. Driven me onward in joy and wonder. In anger and sorrow.

415.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003930_YSHTOLA
415.description: The universe may end, and all may be for naught. But I will live as I always have.

416.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003940_YSHTOLA
416.description: I will always seek out new knowledge. And no conclusion of yours, no matter how grim, can dampen my desire.

417.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003950_EAA
417.description: I suppose it is only to be expected. Their feeble minds cannot fathom the terrifying gravity of it all.

418.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003960_EAB
418.description: But worry not. We consider it our duty to enlighten you, and we will not stop until you grasp the full extent of our despair!

420.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003980_YSHTOLA
420.description: Though my body will soon dissipate, there may be a way to restore it.

421.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_003990_YSHTOLA
421.description: Azem's magick. So long as our souls remain, you can use it to summon us back.

422.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004000_YSHTOLA
422.description: But you mustn't, for it would mean losing our way forward. This, I only reveal so that you can promise not to invoke the magick.

423.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004010_YSHTOLA
423.description: We came here knowing what victory may cost, so press on. Press on, and do not look back.

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004020_URIANGER
424.description: I shall join thee. As subterfuge is not required, thou shalt not suffer for mine absence.

426.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004040_URIANGER
426.description: My resolve hath never been as strong as thine. Full oft have I wavered in my decisions, and afterwards been stricken with regret.

427.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004050_URIANGER
427.description: In spite of this, I may still stand with my comrades, supporting them as they attempt the greatest of feats.

428.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004060_URIANGER
428.description: This truth, I have learned in the course of our journey.

429.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004065_URIANGER
429.description: And many though my shortcomings may be, I may also claim to excel in prophecies. My studies into which have granted me the flexibility of mind needed to bend this malleable reality.

430.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004070_URIANGER
430.description: Thus shall I hope... That thou mayest have the strength to resist, and our comrades the strength to continue.

431.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004080_YSHTOLA
431.description: With you to urge us on, how could we possibly fail?

433.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004100_ALISAIE
433.description: That's right! Our quest doesn't end here. We'll press on...and we <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> find you!

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004110_METEION
434.description: There. That's where you'll find me.

436.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004130_METEION
436.description: Of the stars we visited, most were already devoid of life. And where there was life still, the inhabitants wished for death.

437.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004140_METEION
437.description: But even death, we learned, isn't truly the end. It is but a part of the cycle of rebirth.

438.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004150_METEION
438.description: Souls return to the star─or in its absence, a larger flow. And eventually they are reborn.

439.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004160_METEION
439.description: Alive again, to know suffering anew...

440.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004170_METEION
440.description: True salvation lies not in dying. It lies in not being born.

441.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004180_METEION
441.description: This is the gift I would give to you. To all life on beautiful Etheirys.

442.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004190_METEION
442.description: To that end, we created an egg wherein life cannot quicken─that dead sun.

443.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004200_METEION
443.description: Attain it if you can. Before your friends' emotions fade away─along with their protection.

445.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004220_ALPHINAUD
445.description: As am I. Operating such consoles is trying enough, but if we can't even activate it...

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004240_GRAHATIA
447.description: First, consider the world that has been recreated here.

448.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004250_GRAHATIA
448.description: Its inhabitants were machines who gathered combat data to enhance themselves. And among the many wars they waged, the most notable was that against the dragons.

449.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004260_GRAHATIA
449.description: As you've doubtless surmised, I believe this was the home world of Omega.

450.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004270_GRAHATIA
450.description: Cid built a jamming device to defeat it. A device which generated massive bursts of lightning, its sole weakness.

451.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004280_GRAHATIA
451.description: As you've doubtless surmised, I believe this was the home world of Omega.

452.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004290_GRAHATIA
452.description: According to the records I read in the future, it possessed a single weakness: lightning.

453.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004300_GRAHATIA
453.description: The significance of these details may be lost on you now, but they lead me to believe this was the home world of Omega.

454.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004310_GRAHATIA
454.description: According to the records I read in the future, it possessed a single weakness: lightning.

455.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004320_GRAHATIA
455.description: The significance of these details may be lost on you now, but they lead me to believe this was the home world of Omega.

456.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004330_GRAHATIA
456.description: Aye, I speak of the ancient weapon. The one which the Alliance unleashed upon Shinryu.

457.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004340_GRAHATIA
457.description: I will spare you the long story, but according to the records I read in the future, it possessed a single weakness: lightning.

458.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004350_ALISAIE
458.description: That's all well and good, but what does that─ ...Wait, you're not thinking to strike the console with lightning, are you?

459.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004360_GRAHATIA
459.description: As a matter of fact, I am. Ask yourselves this: why would an entity as puissant as Omega not be designed to suppress the effects of lightning?

460.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004370_ALPHINAUD
460.description: Because it relies upon it─or something akin to it─as a source of energy.

461.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004380_GRAHATIA
461.description: My thoughts exactly. And there is a good chance the same is true of the Omicrons and their devices.

462.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004390_GRAHATIA
462.description: So, shall I cast caution to the wind and try something reckless and dramatic?

465.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_A7_000_002_NONE_VOICE
465.description: I'm not sure this is a good idea.

466.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_A7_000_003_NONE_VOICE
466.description: Or I could use my custom-made Omega Jammer!

468.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004410_GRAHATIA
468.description: Worry not, I will be careful. And if it fails, we can think of something else.

469.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004420_GRAHATIA
469.description: You still have it!? Cid and Nero's legendary device, which brought low the superweapon Omega!?

470.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004430_GRAHATIA
470.description: Wait... The actual device was much too big to lug around, so you must have only the control module. And there I was getting all excited...

471.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004440_GRAHATIA
471.description: Never mind. An old-fashioned spell will suffice.

473.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004460_MASTERSTIGMAONE
473.description: (-???-)Opening connection to Communications Module I... Connection established.

474.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004470_MASTERSTIGMAONE
474.description: (-Sir-)Transmission: strategic Matrix Stigma-1 now online. As the primary strategic matrix, you may address me as “Sir.”

475.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004480_MASTERSTIGMAONE
475.description: (-Sir-)Checking for new communications... None found. All units, please maintain current state.

477.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004500_GRAHATIA
477.description: Wait! We have questions for you!

478.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004510_GRAHATIA
478.description: Of late, no mission orders have been issued. Why not? Has there been some manner of trouble?

479.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004520_MASTERSTIGMAONE
479.description: (-Sir-)Reply: the extended operations unit has yet to determine guidelines for future assignments.

480.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004530_MASTERSTIGMAONE
480.description: (-Sir-)All strategies are calculated, devised, and actioned in accordance with said guidelines.

481.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004540_MASTERSTIGMAONE
481.description: (-Sir-)In the interim, all citizens are directed to maintain a state of combat readiness. End reply. Awaiting query.

482.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004550_ALPHINAUD
482.description: Can you tell us why the extended operations unit hasn't yet determined the guidelines?

483.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004560_MASTERSTIGMAONE
483.description: (-Sir-)Unable to comply. Information unavailable or access restricted.

484.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004570_ALPHINAUD
484.description: In that case, is it possible for us to communicate directly with the unit?

486.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004590_ALISAIE
486.description: Is there anything you can tell us? Have there been any abnormalities, like a threat to the star or widespread unrest?

487.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004600_MASTERSTIGMAONE
487.description: (-Sir-)Reply: negative. All citizens continue to operate at maximum efficiency.

488.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004610_MASTERSTIGMAONE
488.description: (-Sir-)If your operations are suboptimal, please proceed to a maintenance facility for evaluation. Otherwise, standby at your designated post. End reply.

490.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004630_GRAHATIA
490.description: I could activate it again, but I doubt it would be productive. What do you think?

491.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004640_ALISAIE
491.description: If all the Omicrons really were running as efficiently as it claimed, then I doubt they were hoping for life here to end.

492.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004650_ALISAIE
492.description: As this Sir told us, there just haven't been any new instructions, and everyone is standing by.

493.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004660_ALPHINAUD
493.description: Should be standing by, at any rate. If there are those that are neglecting their duties, perhaps we can glean a clue from them.

494.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004670_ALPHINAUD
494.description: I propose we take another look around, and also try to find the operations unit.

495.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004680_M017
495.description: As you have surmised, I am part of the shared intelligence of Stigma-1.

496.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004690_M017
496.description: It is─was my charge to determine the optimal path to achieving our prime function.

497.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004700_M017
497.description: This body had been abandoned by its former owner, and lay unused.

498.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004710_M017
498.description: I took it and abandoned my own─and with it my duty.

499.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004720_GRAHATIA
499.description: May we ask why you did this? From what we gather, it seems to be a personal matter.

500.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004730_M017
500.description: Our kind did not always look as we do now. Long ago, we possessed frail and feeble bodies.

501.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004740_M017
501.description: Beleaguered by stronger races, our ancestors took to augmenting their flesh in order to defend themselves.

502.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004750_M017
502.description: What began with limited parts eventually spread to the whole body. And at last, a means was discovered to convert the mind into data, rendering even the brain obsolete.

503.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004760_M017
503.description: Such complete mechanical beings were called the Omicrons. And by their might, we came to reign supreme over the star.

504.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004770_M017
504.description: But even then, we did not feel secure. For we knew that the universe was home to civilizations aside from our own─civilizations that may be stronger still than us.

505.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004780_M017
505.description: Rather than risk becoming the subjugated, we chose to become the subjugator. We began our conquest of the stars, that we might acquire the resources and knowledge we needed to reign supreme.

506.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004790_M017
506.description: We were successful in that endeavor. So powerful did we become, we could lay low even the mighty dragons.

507.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004800_M017
507.description: But then something unexpected happened. I began experiencing an error: I could no longer determine an optimal path.

509.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004820_M017
509.description: I performed numerous full system scans, each time finding no issues. Yet the error persisted...

510.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004830_M017
510.description: It was then that I speculated: what would happen if we grew so powerful as to have no equal?

511.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004840_M017
511.description: To become stronger was essential to our existence. Our every action has been in service to this objective.

512.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004850_M017
512.description: But if nothing lies beyond this, can it be truly said that it was essential?

513.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004860_M017
513.description: Have we been engaging only in wanton destruction?

514.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004870_ALPHINAUD
514.description: You could find no threat to justify your purpose.

515.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004880_M017
515.description: The Omicrons will never leave this star.

516.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004890_M017
516.description: They will stand by until their reserves of energy are spent. For I have no path to offer them. None.

517.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004900_GRAHATIA
517.description: It is not our place to pass judgment on the deeds of the Omicrons.

518.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004910_GRAHATIA
518.description: But surely this does not have to spell the end of your people?

519.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004920_GRAHATIA
519.description: With your power and knowledge, the possibilities are endless. Why not seek out a new purpose?

521.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004940_M017
521.description: In the beginning, we had a higher purpose than our pursuit of power.

522.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004950_M017
522.description: But we lost sight of it when we so irrevocably altered our fundamental forms.

523.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004960_M017
523.description: When we cast aside our flesh, so too did we cast aside all that defined us. Nothing remains of who we once were.

524.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004970_M017
524.description: I have no aspirations. No longer can I dream. The vital spark is lost.

525.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_004980_M017
525.description: Lost amidst circuitry and code and commands...

527.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005000_GRAHATIA
527.description: I believe I know how to overcome this despair.

528.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005010_GRAHATIA
528.description: The words are ready in my mind, but ere I speak them...

529.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005020_GRAHATIA
529.description: I want you to make me a promise.

530.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005030_GRAHATIA
530.description: Be it across time or space, our promises have always connected us. And so I ask that you indulge me once more, that this won't be the end.

532.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_A8_000_001_NONE_VOICE
532.description: You say it, I'll do it.

534.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005040_GRAHATIA
534.description: Is that so? In that case, I won't hold back.

535.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005050_GRAHATIA
535.description: Forcing you through this again is the last thing I want, and I'm sorry...

536.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005060_GRAHATIA
536.description: But we've never broken a promise to each other. So I ask that you have faith in us, and hear my request.

537.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005070_GRAHATIA
537.description: First, I want to visit Ishgard with you. Properly.

538.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005080_GRAHATIA
538.description: We scarcely had time to look around last time. I should like it very much if you could show me the sights.

539.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005090_GRAHATIA
539.description: Next, you must regale me with your greatest adventures. In the places where you lived them, if possible.

540.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005100_GRAHATIA
540.description: I may have read about all your deeds, but there is no substitute for a firsthand account.

541.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005110_GRAHATIA
541.description: And last but not least, a new adventure together. Unlike any we've experienced before.

542.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005120_GRAHATIA
542.description: We'll travel the lands, cross the seas, and take to the skies upon the eternal wind─and it will be marvelous! It will...

543.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005130_GRAHATIA
543.description: If you would humor me a moment─when we awaken each morning, how can we prove that we're the same individual who retired the night before?

544.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005140_GRAHATIA
544.description: Through the remembrance of past events, we might say. We have our memories. Yet there are times when we forget, or recall incorrectly.

545.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005150_GRAHATIA
545.description: What of our bodies, then? It is the same one, we might say. Yet technically speaking, as living beings, our bodies are constantly changing. It will never be as it was at an earlier point in time.

546.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005160_GRAHATIA
546.description: Our souls are no more immutable. On our star, people are known to inherit the souls of others, yet they are decidedly different beings.

547.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005170_GRAHATIA
547.description: For my part, I've subjected my totality to much and more. I've made my body into an extension of a tower. Blended my soul and memories with those of another self.

548.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005180_GRAHATIA
548.description: And each time, I would ask myself: what is it that makes me, me?

549.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005190_M017
549.description: Were you able to determine an answer?

550.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005200_GRAHATIA
550.description: No. But that doesn't mean I'm confused. It simply means I'm the same as everyone else.

551.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005210_GRAHATIA
551.description: So I posit this: who we were need not prescribe what we now hold in our hearts.

552.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005220_GRAHATIA
552.description: Whatever came before, what matters most is the present.

553.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005230_GRAHATIA
553.description: For me, that is being here with my friends. Full proud of how much we've grown together.

554.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005240_GRAHATIA
554.description: So I urge you to not give up. Heed your heart's desire, and hope that the future you long for shall be realized!

556.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005260_M017
556.description: We cannot understand desire, nor comprehend hope. We do not know how to create such things.

557.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005270_GRAHATIA
557.description: We're not unalike, you and I... I too have struggled to find the courage to express and embrace my wants.

558.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005280_GRAHATIA
558.description: If you like, I will tell you a tale. A tale of a world on the brink. Of a people who never gave up on the future.

559.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005290_GRAHATIA
559.description: Of a man who realized his grandest dreams, and then awakened to a grander reality.

561.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005310_ALISAIE
561.description: You idiot... Just once... Just <hex:021A020203>once<hex:021A020103> stay with us to the end...

563.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005330_ALISAIE
563.description: No. This place is completely deserted, and I can't see how we're supposed to move on from here.

564.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005340_ALPHINAUD
564.description: Neither can I. It's quite the quandary...

565.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005350_ALPHINAUD
565.description: There are no denizens to bar our path, yet there is no way forward.

566.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005360_ALISAIE
566.description: For another mystery, we did find signs of very recent life. You'd swear everyone just vanished into thin air.

567.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005370_ALISAIE
567.description: I wonder, how many ruined worlds like this has Meteion seen?

569.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005390_ALPHINAUD
569.description: Could it be...? Yes... Yes, I believe I may have puzzled this out.

570.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005400_ALPHINAUD
570.description: Despite how it appears, it's no different this time. There is someone here who has wished for this ruin.

571.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005410_ALPHINAUD
571.description: And I believe that, together, Alisaie and I can overcome their will.

574.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_A9_000_002_NONE_VOICE
574.description: I promised your parents I'd keep you safe!

576.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005420_ALPHINAUD
576.description: I'm afraid it has to be done. For our comrades, for everyone on Etheirys...and for myself.

578.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005440_ALPHINAUD
578.description: But if there is a chance this will work, then I would take it. For everyone...and for myself.

579.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005450_ALPHINAUD
579.description: I'm sorry, but there is a chance, and I must seize it. For everyone...and for myself.

580.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005460_ALPHINAUD
580.description: I will not pretend otherwise. I have my fears.

581.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005470_ALPHINAUD
581.description: Not for myself, but for you. The last to remain.

582.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005480_ALPHINAUD
582.description: You are no stranger to carrying the burden of others.

583.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005490_ALPHINAUD
583.description: But I can only imagine how heavy the weight would be this time.

584.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005500_ALPHINAUD
584.description: As your friend, I cannot bear the thought of making you suffer so.

585.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005510_ALISAIE
585.description: Then why suggest such a thing!?

586.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005520_ALISAIE
586.description: It's too much to ask of anyone─even <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>!

587.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005530_ALISAIE
587.description: Why must <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> be the one? Why must <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> fight alone?

588.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005540_ALISAIE
588.description: More than a hero, <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503>'s a dear friend.

589.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005550_ALISAIE
589.description: Not only to us, but to so many others. There are so many people in the world who care for you, and yet...

593.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005590_ALPHINAUD
593.description: Given the nature of this realm, it may be possible to do more than unbar our friend's path. We might also pave <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> a new one.

595.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005610_ALPHINAUD
595.description: A path where he finds happiness at journey's end.

596.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005620_ALPHINAUD
596.description: A path where she finds happiness at journey's end.

597.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005630_ALPHINAUD
597.description: This much, I think we can believe with the utmost conviction. No matter how deep our despair.

598.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005640_ALPHINAUD
598.description: So please, believe in us too. And press on.

601.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005670_ALISAIE
601.description: If the plan's decided, then let's not dally.

602.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005680_METEION
602.description: Ah, there you are. It was as I said, was it not?

603.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005690_ALPHINAUD
603.description: It was. We couldn't find anyone.

604.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005700_ALPHINAUD
604.description: But this place isn't entirely deserted, is it? You are here.

605.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005710_ALPHINAUD
605.description: You sought out a star of promise and found a ruined husk.

606.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005720_ALPHINAUD
606.description: Like us, you explored the devastation. Like us, you were stricken.

607.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005730_ALPHINAUD
607.description: Horrified by the thought that so many lives could be snuffed out as if they were worth nothing.

608.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005740_ALPHINAUD
608.description: And the thought that you would have to bear the terrible tidings to Hermes.

609.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005750_ALPHINAUD
609.description: That which you saw and felt, you shared with your sisters. As did they share their own grim findings with you.

610.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005760_ALPHINAUD
610.description: Overcome by the pervasive despair of these stars, some of you inadvertently ushered their peoples to their ends.

611.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005770_ALPHINAUD
611.description: Knowing the horrors you know, anyone would feel the same. They would fear what lies ahead, and struggle to move forward.

612.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005780_METEION
612.description: Fear... I had forgotten that such a thing existed, so focused have I been on shepherding despair.

613.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005790_ALPHINAUD
613.description: If you can remember, then you can still face and overcome your own fear.

614.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005800_METEION
614.description: Why would I bother with such an insignificant emotion? If the despair I command is as a raging river, then fear is but a trickling stream.

615.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005810_METEION
615.description: It can do nothing to alter my flow.

616.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005820_METEION
616.description: You spoke with the Ea, yes? Heard their tale of what awaits the universe?

617.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005830_METEION
617.description: It's true. The stars grow colder and more distant. Eventually all will enjoy frozen solitude.

618.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005840_METEION
618.description: Using the power of dynamis, I am hastening that process.

619.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005850_METEION
619.description: In so doing, nothing will be born ever again. Everyone will remain dead.

620.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005860_METEION
620.description: Alas, it will take time for that to happen. So in mercy I sent you my gift, to spare you needless suffering.

621.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005870_METEION
621.description: Don't worry. Even if no living witnesses remain to mark the event, I'll make certain that Etheirys has a proper end.

622.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005880_ALISAIE
622.description: For all the power you wield, you're more fearful than the familiar you used to be.

623.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005890_ALISAIE
623.description: That Meteion feared simply to move forward, but your fear is such that you've given up on everything.

624.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005900_ALISAIE
624.description: I know it well. That sense of defeat. I've tasted my fair share of it.

625.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005910_ALISAIE
625.description: But as many times as we've fallen down, we've learned how to pick ourselves up and carry on.

626.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005920_ALISAIE
626.description: We take each other's hand. Share in each other's courage. Follow in each other's footsteps. And turn sorrow into strength!

627.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005930_ALPHINAUD
627.description: There are times when we fail. We bear wounds that do not heal.

628.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005940_ALPHINAUD
628.description: But these experiences are part of life, and they make us stronger!

629.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005950_ALPHINAUD
629.description: (-Alphinaud and Alisaie-)We rise, fall, and rise again!

630.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005960_ALISAIE
630.description: We rise, fall, and rise again!

631.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005970_ALISAIE
631.description: Don't worry about us. You must take the next step, and all the rest after that.

633.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_005980_TATARU
633.description: Please... Please... Oh, please let them all be safe...

637.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006020_KRILE
637.description: They'll be fine... I know they will...

638.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006030_IMMIGRATIONCONTROLSTAFF
638.description: Apologies for the interruption! A man arrived on the last ferry. An associate of the Scions!

639.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006040_IMMIGRATIONCONTROLSTAFF
639.description: He wishes to speak with you at once!

640.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006050_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
640.description: In this city devoid of life, you sense the presence of another...

641.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006060_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
641.description: The sorrow of a thousand thousand worlds weighs heavy. And yet you can walk on.

642.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006070_METEION
642.description: Here the path ends. There is no way to reach our nest.

643.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006080_METEION
643.description: I told you. Resignation and acceptance reign in this place.

644.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006090_METEION
644.description: The rejection of life by those who came to curse it.

645.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006100_METEION
645.description: Those whose dreams were unfulfilled. Whose prayers were unheard. Whose labors were unrewarded.

646.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006110_METEION
646.description: Hope cannot deliver you unto hopelessness. Our refuge is beyond you.

647.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006120_METEION
647.description: Always has it been. Such is the nature of this place.

648.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006130_METEION
648.description: You should have remained on Etheirys.

649.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006140_METEION
649.description: Struggle will avail you naught, nor will it grant your comrades peace.

650.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006150_METEION
650.description: Come, let me relieve you of your burden. You have suffered enough.

652.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006160_YSHTOLA
652.description: Azem's magick. So long as our souls remain, you can use it to summon us back. But you mustn't.

653.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006170_THANCRED
653.description: That's why...it's too soon for this to end.

655.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006190_BLOEWYDA
655.description: Be safe, all of you. And come back.

656.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006200_AMON
656.description: After all these years...is this the answer I was hoping for?

657.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006210_VENAS
657.description: So long as we remember, our fates remain ours to shape.

658.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006220_HYTHLODAEUS
658.description: Perhaps when our time comes to return to the star, we shall remember these few days we have lost.

659.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006230_EMETSELCH
659.description: Do not squander it. The legacy I leave you.

662.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_A10_000_002_NONE_VOICE
662.description: I'll reach you! I'll find a way!

663.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006240_EMETSELCH
663.description: (-???-)I bid them remember, but all this time, <hex:021A020203>I'm<hex:021A020103> the one who had forgotten... A right fool you've made of me, Hermes.

664.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006250_EMETSELCH
664.description: (-???-)And to add insult to injury, I've been denied a sound rest, forced to watch this clamorous show.

665.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006260_HYTHLODAEUS
665.description: (-???-)Oh come now, it's been a gripping tale. Unbreakable bonds and noble sacrifice, sprinkled with moments of levity to counterbalance the pathos. It's got it all.

666.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006270_HYTHLODAEUS
666.description: (-???-)I for one would have been perfectly content to watch enraptured from the stalls...

667.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006280_HYTHLODAEUS
667.description: But I won't say no to a bit part!

669.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006300_EMETSELCH
669.description: Half-faded souls of the dead. Isn't it painfully obvious?

670.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006310_EMETSELCH
670.description: Worry not─we haven't the power to defeat you. Nor is it our duty to do so. Not anymore.

671.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006320_EMETSELCH
671.description: That being said, we do have a score to settle.

672.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006330_EMETSELCH
672.description: So, here I am, Venat. I suppose you needed me to tie it all together, these frayed threads of our history─but knowing you, I suspect there's a joke in it too. Oh yes, I can imagine you gloating over my forgetfulness.

673.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006340_EMETSELCH
673.description: Were I feeling charitable, I might assume you had left room for the possibility of this outcome.

674.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006350_EMETSELCH
