674.description: Even so, you'll get no applause from me. A single gesture will not lighten the burden I've had to bear.

675.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006360_EMETSELCH
675.description: Still, you must be commended. Our methods would not have brought mankind this far.

676.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006370_EMETSELCH
676.description: And so, as a show of respect to the last of us, I make this declaration.

677.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006380_EMETSELCH
677.description: You will not end our journey!

678.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006390_EMETSELCH
678.description: That is our answer! The answer of all lives of Etheirys, past and present!

679.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006400_HYTHLODAEUS
679.description: As you've called us to the stage, so shall we perform. And creation magicks never fail to please.

680.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006410_HYTHLODAEUS
680.description: Drawing upon the hopes of your comrades, we will make for you a new path.

681.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006420_EMETSELCH
681.description: What form said path takes depends on you. So focus─focus and envision that which rejects the claim that you cannot attain your goal!

682.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006430_HYTHLODAEUS
682.description: Ours is the wisdom to weave the fabric of reality...

683.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006440_HYTHLODAEUS
683.description: Ours is the power to create!

685.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006460_HERMES
685.description: Though I gave you these wings to soar the heavens, I did not teach you how to walk the earth. So loath was I to bind another living being.

686.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006470_HERMES
686.description: In the course of your long journey, you will learn from those you meet. Learn to walk and run and so much more.

688.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006490_HERMES
688.description: Yes. Upon your return, I will gift you a beautiful flower.

689.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006500_EMETSELCH
689.description: These Elpis blooms serve as proof that this realm is not utterly devoid of hope. No more can you deny its power. No more is yours the dominion of despair.

690.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006510_EMETSELCH
690.description: In case the practical implications were lost on you, your comrades no longer need fight their fight.

691.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006520_EMETSELCH
691.description: So, go on. Call them back to your side.

692.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006530_HYDAELYN
692.description: May you ever walk...in the light...

693.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006540_THANCRED
693.description: How disappointing. Not even a single scar in the making to brag about.

696.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006570_YSHTOLA
696.description: Honestly... This is far more than any of us could have hoped for. Let us be thankful.

697.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006580_URIANGER
697.description: Indeed. That we thus stand reunited is a gift. Let us not squander it, and see that we all return to Etheirys.

698.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006590_GRAHATIA
698.description: Aye, as soon as we've averted the Final Days!

699.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006600_ALISAIE
699.description: Good to see you again. Our heroic sacrifice paid off, I take it?

700.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006610_ALPHINAUD
700.description: Come, my friends. Let us carry on and finish it─together.

706.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006640_METEION
706.description: The voices within... Crying in pain, wailing in sorrow... Hurting... Hurting...

707.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006650_METEION
707.description: End it...silence it... Silence our song of oblivion!

708.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006660_HYTHLODAEUS
708.description: The way is open. They can proceed.

711.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006690_EMETSELCH
711.description: Of course. The encore is finished, and I will not suffer myself to live again by Hydaelyn's magick.

712.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006700_EMETSELCH
712.description: But more than that, the future you seek is not the past we loved. That is why we fought. And why I lost.

713.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006710_EMETSELCH
713.description: But though you defeated me, my ideals are inviolate. Invincible.

714.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006720_EMETSELCH
714.description: Spare me your pity. I have no use for it. If you would do something for me─save our star.

715.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006730_EMETSELCH
715.description: See this tale to a triumphant conclusion, and with elation in your hearts, bid the final curtain fall.

716.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006740_EMETSELCH
716.description: Only then may it rise again and a new tale begin─with new parts for all to play.

718.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006760_EMETSELCH
718.description: Tell me, have you been to the ruins beneath the waters of the Bounty?

719.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006770_EMETSELCH
719.description: Or the treasure islands beyond the frozen waters of Blindfrost, in Othard's north?

720.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006780_EMETSELCH
720.description: The fabled golden cities of the New World? The sacred sites of the forgotten people of the south sea isles?

721.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006790_EMETSELCH
721.description: What about Meracydia, the southern continent? Do you know aught of its present state of affairs?

722.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006800_EMETSELCH
722.description: ...I thought not. Even of your little Eorzea, you know precious little. The true identities of the Twelve, for instance.

723.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006810_EMETSELCH
723.description: All of which is to say: expand your horizons. Go forth and seek discovery. Some of the civilizations in the reflections will surprise you.

724.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006820_EMETSELCH
724.description: As the bearer of Azem's crystal, you may consider your duty to see at least that much.

727.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006850_HYTHLODAEUS
727.description: I pray we meet again. If not in this life, then perhaps another.

728.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006860_HYTHLODAEUS
728.description: Whensoever it should be, I trust it will be a most joyous reunion.

729.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006870_EMETSELCH
729.description: For you, maybe. I want nothing to do with it.

731.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006890_METEION
731.description: So you are finally here. In this place between death and rebirth, where life knows no dawn.

732.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006900_METEION
732.description: Come, then. Follow me down into the darkest depths of despair.

733.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006910_METEION
733.description: That you still stand... Your determination defies all reason.

734.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006920_METEION
734.description: The souls within me writhe and recoil in your presence...

735.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006930_METEION
735.description: What must I do? What pain must I visit upon you to make you surrender to despair?

736.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006940_ALISAIE
736.description: No one is unbreakable. What pains one may weather may bring another to tears.

737.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006950_ALISAIE
737.description: But therein lies our strength, for when we fall, our brothers and sisters are there to raise us up. Again and again. Without end.

739.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006970_METEION
739.description: But no matter how much hope exists, ever will there be more despair.

740.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006980_EAA
740.description: But no matter how much hope exists, ever will there be more despair.

741.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_006990_EAB
741.description: But no matter how much hope exists, ever will there be more despair.

742.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007000_MASTERSTIGMAONE
742.description: But no matter how much hope exists, ever will there be more despair.

743.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007010_METEION
743.description: Ever will the living curse the present and lament the future.

744.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007020_EAA
744.description: Ever will the living curse the present and lament the future.

745.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007030_EAB
745.description: Ever will the living curse the present and lament the future.

746.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007040_MASTERSTIGMAONE
746.description: Ever will the living curse the present and lament the future.

747.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007050_METEION
747.description: So shall we sing until life ceases to be.

748.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007060_EAA
748.description: So shall we sing until life ceases to be.

749.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007070_EAB
749.description: So shall we sing until life ceases to be.

750.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007080_MASTERSTIGMAONE
750.description: So shall we sing until life ceases to be.

753.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007110_ENDSINGER
753.description: Ahhh, the rage... It rises... Rises...

759.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007170_ENDSINGER
759.description: We die in pain. We die in suffering! Who are you to live? Who are you to hope!?

765.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007230_ENDSINGER
765.description: We cannot comprehend. We cannot know. We cannot know!

766.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007240_METEION
766.description: Don't, please! Don't do this to them. To yourself!

775.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007330_ENDSINGER
775.description: All awash in ice. A frozen waste. Forever silent!

780.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007380_ENDSINGER
780.description: Bereft of the synergy you claim is your strength. Unless you mean to call upon the dead once more.

781.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007390_ENDSINGER
781.description: Defiant to the last. But you will be one with us ere long.

782.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007400_ENDSINGER
782.description: You will be battered and torn and made to crawl. You will weep and wail and curse your impotence. Curse your life as it fades.

783.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007410_ENDSINGER
783.description: As we did! As we died!

784.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007420_ENDSINGER
784.description: Such pain and sorrow we felt... Such anguish and rage... We tried. We tried. But it was no use...

785.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007430_ENDSINGER
785.description: Only when we surrendered did we find release. Only when we embraced death.

786.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007440_ENDSINGER
786.description: So join us in despair...and embrace yours!

788.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007460_ZENOS
788.description: At the end of everything I find you, my friend.

789.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007470_ZENOS
789.description: I sought something in you, once. As you did in me.

790.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007480_ZENOS
790.description: When at last I understood what it was, I journeyed to Sharlayan to seek you out. Struck a bargain with the woman who shares your gift.

791.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007510_ZENOS
791.description: In exchange for lending the Scions my aid, I was given the means to come hither.

792.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007520_ZENOS
792.description: Gorging upon what remained of the Mothercrystal, I reclaimed the form of the dragon. And hungry still for our reunion, I rode the light of the stars to you.

793.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007530_ZENOS
793.description: I take it this is your prey.

794.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007550_ZENOS
794.description: But why does it still live? Surely it is no match for you.

795.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007560_ZENOS
795.description: I had assumed you would be above something so banal as despair. Am I mistaken?

798.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_A12_000_002_NONE_VOICE
798.description: If it comes to it, I won't save you.

800.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007580_ZENOS
800.description: And I'd rather not give it. Nay, I would have preferred that we enjoy a private reunion.

801.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007590_ZENOS
801.description: I care not. What I desire of you isn't succor. It is satisfaction.

802.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007600_ZENOS
802.description: So come, let us dispense with this distraction, you and I!

803.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007610_ENDSINGER
803.description: You struggle in vain. You will not silence our song of oblivion!

804.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007620_ENDSINGER
804.description: You will never reach it. Will never reach the deliverance you seek.

805.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007630_ENDSINGER
805.description: If this...was not the answer...then what is it? Where lies...happiness...?

806.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007640_METEION
806.description: No matter where we flew, there was only darkness and loneliness and pain.

807.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007650_METEION
807.description: We couldn't find the answers Hermes yearned for. The answers he deserved.

808.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007660_METEION
808.description: Greetings... You who are my final encounter...

809.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007670_METEION
809.description: I wish to hear your words... Share your feelings... Know your thoughts.

812.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007700_METEION
812.description: Yes, I can see them... The memories of a long, long journey...

813.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007710_METEION
813.description: So many people... The thoughts of them overflowing in your heart...

814.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007720_METEION
814.description: What they live for, what gives their lives meaning... There was never a single answer.

815.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007730_METEION
815.description: You gather pieces of happiness, precious and fragile, only to lose them. Then start again.

816.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007740_METEION
816.description: On and on it goes, until death takes you into its gentle embrace.

817.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007750_METEION
817.description: That which Hermes sent us to find...was there all this time. On Etheirys.

821.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007760_METEION
821.description: Like a field of flowers, perhaps. At first a single blossom, it spreads and takes on more colors.

822.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007770_METEION
822.description: Thank you for guiding me here. To find these words at journey's end fills me with joy.

823.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007780_METEION
823.description: And so, before I fall forever silent, there is one thing I must do.

824.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007790_METEION
824.description: No expression of regret will undo what my sisters and I have done. Will restore what we have stolen.

825.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007800_METEION
825.description: But if you would allow it, I would sing one last song. A song of the newfound joy that swells in my heart...

826.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007810_METEION
826.description: Of the beauty of light when it shines across a dark and starless sea...

827.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007820_METEION
827.description: Of a dream that from the soil of worlds now lost to sorrow, life will spring forth once more...

828.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007830_METEION
828.description: ...Nourished by gentle rains and caressed by uplifting winds. A song of hope.

829.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007840_METEION
829.description: One day, life will fill the universe again. And Hermes will see this and smile.

830.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007850_METEION
830.description: How, I do not know. But I do know that, where there is a will, there is a way.

831.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007860_METEION
831.description: After all, miracles happen every day, do they not?

833.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007880_METEION
833.description: I will create a path back to your ship, where your dear friends await.

834.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007890_METEION
834.description: Hold in your heart your desire to return to them, then follow my lead and walk forth.

835.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007900_METEION
835.description: That hope will surely guide you true.

836.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007910_ZENOS
836.description: You mean to return. To the world where you are hailed as a hero.

837.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007920_ZENOS
837.description: Hear me then. Not as a hero, but as simply...you.

838.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007930_ZENOS
838.description: As I learned in Ala Mhigo, you are a formidable foe.

839.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007940_ZENOS
839.description: Stronger than any I have faced. Against you, I need bring my all to bear.

840.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007950_ZENOS
840.description: I need burn through the candle of my life.

841.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007960_ZENOS
841.description: This is the sole pleasure I know, and it is the sole pleasure I have to share.

842.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007970_ZENOS
842.description: And so I come before you. To issue challenge and offer singular bliss.

843.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007980_ZENOS
843.description: If you wish to walk away, I will not stop you.

844.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_007990_ZENOS
844.description: You value life. You do not burn yours save for reasons you deem worthy.

845.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008000_ZENOS
845.description: Reasons such as those which brought you here. The salvation of a world and its people. The motives of a hero true.

846.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008010_ZENOS
846.description: But there is more to you than that. You know this to be true.

847.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008020_ZENOS
847.description: As surely as you know the thrill of pushing your body and soul to their limits. Of confronting ever-mightier foes, dancing ever closer to the precipice, wondering if this will be the one to finally, finally...fill the void.

848.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008030_ZENOS
848.description: Such pleasures, you seek for their own sake, and no other reason. Is this not so...<hex:021A020203>adventurer<hex:021A020103>?

851.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_A14_000_002_NONE_VOICE
851.description: Think what you will. But I'm not letting you leave this place.

852.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_A14_000_003_NONE_VOICE
852.description: I've had enough of you. It ends here.

855.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008060_ZENOS
855.description: The conflagration of our clash will scorch even the stars!

856.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008070_ZENOS
856.description: So you would still play the hero.

857.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008080_ZENOS
857.description: No matter. In acceptance you betray your deception. You know full well what we are, and what we seek.

858.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008090_ZENOS
858.description: To shine incandescent in death's shadow!

859.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008095_ZENOS
859.description: Finally mustered the desire to kill me, have you?

860.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008096_ZENOS
860.description: Go on, then. Try and strike me down in this forsaken place. I shall return the favor.

861.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008097_ZENOS
861.description: Aye, let us indulge in the only worthwhile pursuit, and burn our lives to their ends!

867.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008150_ZENOS
867.description: Never have I understood those around me. Understood their obsessions.

868.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008160_ZENOS
868.description: Besieged by their banality, the world was a mire of tedium and trivialities.

869.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008170_ZENOS
869.description: But in these fleeting moments, there is...a spark. Blinding, brilliant...

871.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008190_ZENOS
871.description: What of you, my mirror? Born into this world, bestowed name, bid to seek out strife and adventure...

872.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008200_ZENOS
872.description: Was this life a gift...or a burden?

882.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008300_ALISAIE
882.description: You can't leave us... Not like this...

883.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008310_ALISAIE
883.description: If you do, I'll never forgive you... So, come on! Open your eyes and get up!

886.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008340_ALPHINAUD
886.description: Thank the heavens... For a moment we thought...

890.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008350_GRAHATIA
890.description: After what you've done, you're the last person...

896.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008410_GRAHATIA
896.description: You... How can you keep your promise if you're not here?

897.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008420_ESTINIEN
897.description: Another fine show you've put on, my friend.

899.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008440_YSHTOLA
899.description: What were you thinking, fighting alone? Never do that again. My poor heart couldn't bear it.

900.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008450_THANCRED
900.description: Put yourself in our place. If you hadn't returned, how do you think we would feel? And if that sounds harsh...it's because we care.

901.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008460_URIANGER
901.description: We tended to thy wounds as best we could, but how is the pain?

902.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008470_URIANGER
902.description: That is gladdening. Grievous as thine injuries were, however, I would counsel repose for a time.

905.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008500_ALISAIE
905.description: When Meteion appeared in here and told us that you were right behind her, we all got our hopes up. But you never came!

906.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008510_ALISAIE
906.description: And when you finally deign to appear, you're within an ilm of your life!

907.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008520_ALISAIE
907.description: Damn you! Damn you for making us worry!

908.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008530_LIVINGWAY
908.description: Ah, those were cries of celebration.

909.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008540_LIVINGWAY
909.description: Anyway, what the important thing is that you're all alive and in reasonably good health, and we mean to get you back that way.

910.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008550_LIVINGWAY
910.description: As for your earlier request, I'm quite certain we're in range to make contact now.

911.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008560_THANCRED
911.description: Ah, excellent. Let us announce our return at once.

914.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008590_ALPHINAUD
914.description: While you were unconscious, we set out from Ultima Thule, you see.

915.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008600_ALPHINAUD
915.description: Can you stand? If so, you may wish to see what's outside.

916.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008610_ALPHINAUD
916.description: We're home, my friend. We're home!

918.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008630_ERENVILLE
918.description: It is! It's the <hex:021A020203>Ragnarok<hex:021A020103>! They're back!

931.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008760_ALPHINAUD
931.description: This letter will be the very last that I write to you from the Rising Stones.

932.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008770_ALPHINAUD
932.description: As I commit these words to parchment, I fondly recall my journey as a Scion.

933.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008780_ALPHINAUD
933.description: From the time I first walked into the order's former halls...to the time I set forth to forestall the Final Days.

934.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008790_ALPHINAUD
934.description: At the farthest reaches of the sea of stars, we fought the battle of our lives...

935.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008800_ALPHINAUD
935.description: Fought against despair itself─a veritable maelstrom of it fed by the resignation that dwelled in the hearts of beings not so unlike ourselves.

936.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008810_ALPHINAUD
936.description: Full oft have I harbored the same malaise. Have I been brought to my knees, crushed by the weight of sorrow and defeat, convinced that I will never rise again.

938.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008830_ALPHINAUD
938.description: I have also known many moments of unbridled joy and happiness.

939.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008840_ALPHINAUD
939.description: By this truth do I find hope within, blooming resplendent like the Elpis flower.

941.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008860_ALPHINAUD
941.description: Do I look forward to creating more memories with my friends and loved ones.

942.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008865_ALPHINAUD
942.description: For from these fertile seeds, yet more hope shall spring forth...

943.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008870_ALPHINAUD
943.description: And they will grow to become shining lights that illuminate the dark.

944.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008880_ALPHINAUD
944.description: Thus believing, I leave the Rising Stones behind, as will my comrades.

945.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008890_ALPHINAUD
945.description: For as we have decided after careful deliberation...

946.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008900_ALPHINAUD
946.description: We are disbanding the Scions of the Seventh Dawn.

948.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008920_TATARU
948.description: Everyone is already gathered in the foyer!

949.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008930_ALPHINAUD
949.description: My apologies. I'll be right there.

950.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008940_ALPHINAUD
950.description: At least...that is what the story will be.

951.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008950_ALPHINAUD
951.description: Sorry to keep you all waiting.

952.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008960_ALISAIE
952.description: What could you possibly have left to do now?

954.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008980_THANCRED
954.description: I imagine it will be a while before we can gather like this again.

955.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_008990_YSHTOLA
955.description: So it must be if we're to keep up appearances.

956.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009000_YSHTOLA
956.description: From now on, it falls to the Grand Company of Eorzea and its allies to deal with the realm's crises.

957.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009010_URIANGER
957.description: Meanwhile, we shall return to our erstwhile ways.

958.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009020_URIANGER
958.description: Retreating from plain sight to take our place in the shadows once more.

959.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009030_ALPHINAUD
959.description: Indeed. For the foreseeable future, I expect that we must work independently as we seek out problems that want for solving.

960.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009040_ALPHINAUD
960.description: But a day will come when we face another great challenge. And we will face it together, as we always have.

961.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009050_KRILE
961.description: As much as I look forward to that day, I do hope it doesn't come any time soon...

962.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009060_ESTINIEN
962.description: Well, formal association or no, if any of you should require my services, you need but ask.

963.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009070_ESTINIEN
963.description: I'll be glad to keep my lance arm honed.

964.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009080_THANCRED
964.description: I'll hold you to that, so you had better keep your linkpearl on hand.

965.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009090_ALISAIE
965.description: So, you really mean to stay, Tataru?

966.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009100_TATARU
966.description: Someone has to keep the Rising Stones in proper order, and even a super-secret organization requires a super-secret base of operations.

967.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009110_TATARU
967.description: To the rest of the world, it will be naught more than a workshop for Eorzea's foremost up-and-coming artisan!

968.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009120_TATARU
968.description: If you thought our coffers were full to bursting before, just wait till I can devote myself wholly to the crafts.

969.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009130_ALISAIE
969.description: Plotting to build a mercantile empire to rival that of Lord Lolorito, are we?

971.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009140_GRAHATIA
971.description: I, for one, look forward to your future successes, Tataru, as do I our next meeting.

972.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009150_TATARU
972.description: And with that, I believe it is past time you all made ready to depart.

973.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009160_TATARU
973.description: Leave no preparations undone or words unsaid, all right? Now, off with you!

974.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009170_ALISAIE
974.description: I suppose we're off to Garlemald, then.

975.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009180_ALISAIE
975.description: Though we ought to speak with Lord Aymeric first. If he's received word of any recent developments, we need to know.

976.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009190_ALPHINAUD
976.description: 'Twould be prudent to purchase some warmer clothes at least. Mayhap we can pick up a few souvenirs for Jullus and the others while we're at it.

977.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009200_ALISAIE
977.description: Where will you all be heading next?

978.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009210_YSHTOLA
978.description: Dravania. There is a book I have been meaning to borrow from the Great Gubal Library.

979.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009220_YSHTOLA
979.description: And I can think of at least one person who will be most displeased should I fail to visit before leaving.

980.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009230_THANCRED
980.description: We've no particular destination in mind, but we do intend to stop in Sharlayan before we set off.

981.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009240_URIANGER
981.description: We had thought to ask after the Loporrits. I am curious as to how well those who chose to remain are adapting to their changed circumstances.

982.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009250_KRILE
982.description: Might we accompany you, then? Raha and I were planning to return to the Baldesion Annex.

983.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009260_GRAHATIA
983.description: Commissions have been piling up in our absence, and they must be dealt with ere we begin our work in earnest.

984.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009270_ALPHINAUD
984.description: Estinien. You will return to Radz-at-Han, will you not?

985.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009280_ESTINIEN
985.description: Aye. For Vrtra's benefit, though I've yet to hear the details. I may not stay long.

986.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009290_ALPHINAUD
986.description: I see. Then it is here the Scions at last part ways, each to some far-flung corner of the realm.

987.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009300_YSHTOLA
987.description: Perhaps. But I believe one of our number─a rather important one, at that─has yet to divulge <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> plans.

991.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009340_ALPHINAUD
991.description: So. What's next for our humble adventurer?

992.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009350_ELIDIBUS
992.description: (-???-)The constancy of this place never ceases to amaze me. An ocean of souls, shimmering and eternal.

994.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009370_ELIDIBUS
994.description: (-???-)Yes... Steeped in darkness deep as starless night, the beast hungers.

995.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009380_ELIDIBUS
995.description: (-???-)Alas, I dare not investigate in earnest before the coming of my guiding star, as he foretold.

996.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009390_ELIDIBUS
996.description: (-???-)Alas, I dare not investigate in earnest before the coming of my guiding star, as she foretold.

997.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009400_ELIDIBUS
997.description: (-???-)We shall descend to the depths, you and I, to confront the dread beast Pandæmonium.

998.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06006_009410_ELIDIBUS
998.description: (-???-)Oh, the sights we shall see. The sights we shall see.
